text:
ben_support: FYI - customer reported a code-gen regression after yesterday's rollout. Pasting their message below. Ticket #CS-4278.

ben_support: "Hi Redwood support — after the 3/14 rollout our code generation started producing snippets that fail to compile. Example: generated TypeScript function missing return and semicolons, and a unit test that references a renamed helper. This worked fine on model `code-gen-v3.1` last week; now we're on `code-gen-v3.2`. We can consistently repro with the payload below. Please advise — this is breaking our CI."

ben_support: Customer pasted repro (sanitized):
```bash
curl -sS https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model":"code-gen-v3.2",
    "input":"Write a TypeScript function generateInvoice(items: Item[]): string that returns valid TypeScript code and compiles",
    "temperature":0.0,
    "max_tokens":512
  }'
```

ben_support: Model output they got (truncated):
```ts
function generateInvoice(items: Item[]): string {
  const lines = items.map(i => `${i.name} x ${i.qty}`)
  lines.join('\n')
  // missing return
}

// test
const invoice = generateInvoice([{name: 'a', qty: 1}])
expect(invoice).toContain('a x 1')
```

ben_support: Build error from customer's CI: `error TS2365: Function lacks ending return statement and return type does not include 'undefined'.` They also saw style drift (no semicolons) and missing helper calls.

maria_gonzalez: Thanks for the ticket. I grabbed the request/response headers from the customer: model header `code-gen-v3.2+opt`, request id `rwd-9c7f`. They say they pinned everything else.

maria_gonzalez: @lee_dev can you confirm whether any post-processing or formatters were changed in the code-gen rollout? I know we toggled the default `format_preserve` flag in the runtime yesterday.

lee_dev: Seeing the deploy-bot note: 

deploy-bot: Canary rollout deploy/2026-03-14_21:05 by @release-manager completed -> traffic 100% for `code-gen-v3.2` (commit 4f9a2b).

lee_dev: I pulled the release notes — there was a change: default sampling moved from `temperature=0.0` to `temperature=0.2` for general-purpose code models to encourage diversity. Also toggled `strip_trailing_return=false` -> accidentally flipped in one config file to true for code-gen models. That could explain missing returns.

priya_ml: Hmm that toggle (`strip_trailing_return`) was intended only for natural language summarizers. If it flipped on for code models, our post-processing may drop last expression/return statements when it looks like noise. That would definitely cause compilation errors.

ben_support: Customer asked for a hotfix or rollback. They have CI failing on main branch and it's blocking deploys.

lee_dev: We should confirm repro locally. I just ran their curl with `code-gen-v3.2` and default temp — got similar missing return and no semicolons. Re-run with `code-gen-v3.2` but explicitly set `format_preserve=true` and `strip_trailing_return=false` in request metadata -> output includes return and semicolons.

lee_dev: Minimal repro script I used (Node):
```js
const r = await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${process.env.RWD}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
  body: JSON.stringify({
    model: 'code-gen-v3.2',
    input: 'Write a TypeScript function generateInvoice(items: Item[]): string that returns valid TypeScript code and compiles',
    temperature: 0.0,
    metadata: { format_preserve: true, strip_trailing_return: false }
  })
})
console.log(await r.text())
```

priya_ml: Good catch. Looks like the canary config accidentally included a global config override. I'll roll a patch to revert `strip_trailing_return` for code models.

priya_ml: Quick plan: 1) Temporary mitigation: advise customers to set `metadata.format_preserve=true` and `metadata.strip_trailing_return=false` or pin to `code-gen-v3.1`. 2) Patch the runtime config and promote a canary rollback ASAP. 3) Root cause: mistaken config merge in deploy manifest commit 4f9a2b.

ben_support: Customer requested ETA. Can we give an estimate?

lee_dev: If ML can push a config patch, ops can flip the flag within ~30 minutes. If not possible, we can target a 1-2 hour rollback.

priya_ml: I'll open an urgent PR to fix the manifest and request a canary redeploy. PR: https://git.redwood/repo/infra/commit/4f9a2b (private) — title: "revert accidental strip_trailing_return for code models".

ops-bot: Incident created -> INC-2026-045. Pager on-call for eng-runtime.

maria_gonzalez: Ben, please send the customer's CI logs and a minimal testcase to INC-2026-045 so eng can attach. Also ask them to try the workaround pinning to `code-gen-v3.1` if possible.

ben_support: Sent logs and repro to the incident. Customer confirmed the workaround pinned to v3.1 works for now. They asked to be notified when the rollback/patch is live.

lee_dev: Action items: @priya_ml push patch, @release-manager trigger canary redeploy, ops to monitor errors/CI failures metric `codegen.compile_errors`. We'll keep this thread updated.

priya_ml: Patch merged, canary redeploy started at 1832001500.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy/2026-03-14_21:50 started (patch revert 5a1d2c).

lee_dev: Monitoring shows compile_errors metric dropping in the canary subset. I see customer request ids returning code with semicolons and valid returns.

ben_support: Customer confirmed tests passing on their side after we applied patch to canary and then promoted to prod. They asked for a postmortem and a safeguard to prevent config merges that affect code models.

maria_gonzalez: Noted — we'll file a postmortem and add a pre-merge CI check to detect config keys that target code models.

priya_ml: I'll prepare a short RCA: accidental config merge in release 4f9a2b set `strip_trailing_return=true` globally; regression surfaced in code-gen-v3.2 after rollout; mitigation: revert, add CI gates, and educate release engineers.

ben_support: Closing loop with customer now. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

maria_gonzalez: Leaving this here for records. We'll attach INC-2026-045 and the PR.

lee_dev: Follow-up: run a quick sweep for other flags that might have been toggled in that commit (formatting, newline trimming) — I found `remove_trailing_commas=false` was also flipped; will add tests.

ben_support: Great catch. I'll add a note to the customer that we did a full sweep and added the workaround details and ETA.

maria_gonzalez: End of thread.
